help.short: The name of the virtual network gateway.
Attempt to recalculate the Resiliency Information for the gateway

description: This operation retrieves the resiliency information for an Express Route Gateway, including the gateway's current resiliency score and recommendations to further improve the score

operations.description: This operation retrieves the resiliency information for an Express Route Gateway, including the gateway's current resiliency score and recommendations to further improve the score

params.description: The name of the resource group.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The subscription credentials which uniquely identify the Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

params.description: The name of the virtual network gateway.
params.name: virtualNetworkGatewayName

params.description: Attempt to recalculate the Resiliency Information for the gateway
params.name: attemptRefresh

props.description: List of Resiliency based Recommendation Components for the gateway
Max score that the gateway can achieve if the specified recommendation is applied
props.name: maxScore

props.description: Name of the Resiliency based Recommendation Component
props.name: name

props.description: List of Gateway Resiliency based Recommendations
Link to the public documentation for the associated recommendation
props.name: callToActionLink

props.description: Acton items to apply the recommendation
props.name: callToActionText
recommendations
components

props.description: Timestamp denoting the last time when the resiliency score was computed for the gateway
props.name: lastComputedTime

props.description: Maximum increase expected in the score if all of the recommendations are applied for the gateway
props.name: maxScoreFromRecommendations

props.description: Minimum increase expected in the score if the at least one of the recommendations is applied for the gateway
props.name: minScoreFromRecommendations

props.description: Timestamp denoting the next eligible time to re-compute the resiliency score for the gateway
props.name: nextEligibleComputeTime

props.description: Current Resiliency Score for the gateway
props.name: overallScore

props.description: Update in the Resiliency Score for the gateway from the last computed score
props.name: scoreChange
